 Post published at 18:31 GMT 18:31 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-1 Hoffenheim 
 Hoffenheim have a corner and Ozan Kabak was ghosting in but it was a poor header that sails over the bar.
 Should've done better.
 13 12 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 18:30 GMT 18:30 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 I want Bournemouth to win but come on, that goal was fantastic.
 Harry 
 44 8 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Hoffenheim 'ticked a lot of the boxes' so far published at 18:29 GMT 18:29 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-1 Hoffenheim 
 Glenn Hoddle 
Former England and Tottenham manager on TNT Sports 
 It's been a decent game. There's been a good energy about it, and as the away side Hoffenheim have ticked a lot of boxes. In possession, defensively and on the counter.
 14 25 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:29 GMT 18:29 GMT 
 Sparta Prague 1-0 Bournemouth 
 "Ebrima is a dynamic player blessed with both pace and physical strength, as well as excellent movement. One of his biggest assets is his versatility, allowing him to operate in all attacking positions. He actively seeks out one-on-one situations, is dangerous when attacking open spaces and making runs into the penalty area, and consistently supports the box in the final third," is what Sparta sporting director Tomas Rosicky said in the summer when they signed him.
 He wasn't wrong!
 13 6 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:29 GMT 18:29 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-1 Hoffenheim 
 Jaydee Canvot releases Anan Khalaili in behind the Hoffenheim defence and he squares across for Jean-Philippe Mateta but the striker misses the target.
 8 20 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:27 GMT 18:27 GMT 
 Sparta Prague 1-0 Bournemouth 
 Sparta keeper Jakub Surovcík, who got the assist for their goal, saves from Alvaro Rodriguez's header.
 6 22 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:26 GMT 18:26 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-1 Hoffenheim 
 Palace win a corner and Adam Wharton swings it in but it's headed behind for another.
 The second one doesn't result in a shot on goal either.
 12 36 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Strange from Guddal' published at 18:26 GMT 18:26 GMT 
 Sparta Prague 1-0 Bournemouth 
 Joe Partington 
Former Bournemouth defender on BBC Radio Solent 
 It's such a strange decision from the defender. It's an aimless long ball from James Hill and Tobias Guddal turns around and rugby tackles Alvaro Rodriguez.
 This is a huge opportunity now for the Cherries.
 58 6 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:26 GMT 18:26 GMT 
 Sparta Prague 1-0 Bournemouth 
 Sparta's goal was the first time Bournemouth have conceded a goal in almost a month.
 It ends their hope of a club-record seventh consecutive clean sheet.
 6 18 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Incredible goal' published at 18:24 GMT 18:24 GMT 
 Sparta Prague 1-0 Bournemouth 
 Joe Partington 
Former Bournemouth defender on BBC Radio Solent 
 What a goal from Ebrima Singhateh. He drives and drives and drives with the ball and just when it looks like he's run out of room, he gets through a gap and slots it past the goalkeeper.
 That is an incredible goal. 
 41 28 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 RED CARD - SPARTA published at 18:24 GMT 18:24 GMT 
 Sparta Prague 1-0 Bournemouth 
 Sparta, seconds after taking the lead, go down to 10 men!
 Tobias Guddal, already on a booking, wrestles down Bournemouth's Alvaro Rodriguez and gets his second yellow card.
 Image source, Reuters 
 176 30 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:23 GMT 18:23 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-1 Hoffenheim 
 Glenn Hoddle 
Former England and Tottenham manager on TNT Sports 
 The two inside forwards Pino and Kamada are picking up some lovely positions.
 58 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:23 GMT 18:23 GMT 
 FC Thun 1-0 Hearts 
 Over in Switzerland it's a nightmare night so far for Hearts as FC Thum add a second.
 And this one comes from another defensive mistake as skipper Stephen Kingsley fails to clear a cross and Brighton Labeau sweeps the ball into the net.
 Hearts are 34th in the Conference League rankings as things stand. 
 Follow Hearts' match right here. 
 11 7 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Sparta Prague 1-0 Bournemouth published at 18:22 GMT 18:22 GMT 
 Ebrima Singhateh (35 mins) 
 What a solo goal this is. Unbelievable from Ebrima Singhateh. 
 Bournemouth are on the attack and Jakub Surovcik catches the ball. He throws it out to Singhateh, who is still in his own half.
 He beats Lewis Cook in midfield to race away and skips through three players in the box before slotting in.
 Image source, Reuters
